**`notes/store.py`** — added `update`, placed between `get` and `delete`, following the existing style:

```python
def update(self, note_id: str, title: Optional[str] = None, body: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
    note = self.notes.get(note_id)
    if note is None:
        return False
    if title is not None:
        note["title"] = title
    if body is not None:
        note["body"] = body
    self.save()
    return True
```

Only `title` and `body` are touched; `tags` and `due` are left alone. `None` means "leave unchanged" (so you cannot blank a field with `None`, and passing `""` does set it empty). Returns `False` without saving when the id is unknown.
